guidanceReview.rationale: Retains recovery after control loss, cancellation after the last client exits, and atomic supervisor status without replaying interrupted switches. Security fixes refresh transitive HTTP parsing, proxy trust, IP validation, URI parsing, copying, and brace expansion within declared parent ranges. The SDK already supports Node server adapter 2; its removed Node 18 and Vercel paths are unused here. Tool guidance, control and extension protocols, and durable state remain compatible with 1.0.2 and earlier epoch-1 releases.
